note: Public keys that may sign dataset release manifests. A manifest is installed only when its signature verifies with one of these keys. The project has no production release key yet: the owner adds one here (scope "any") when the release location is chosen (JOBLEFT_DATASET_MANIFEST_URL). Until then only local test releases can be installed.

keys.note: TEST KEY. Its private key is in packages/static-data/test/fixtures/release-test-key.pem, so it is trusted only for manifests served from 127.0.0.1 or localhost (the mock release server).
